mapper.select: SELECT fdp.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID AS pledgeFinprodId, NVL(fdp.PLEDGE_NUMBER,0) * 100 AS pledgePrin, NVL(fdp.PLEDGE_AMT,0) AS pledgeAmt, NVL(fdp.PLEDGE_RATIO,0)*100 AS pledgeRatio FROM FIN_DEAL_PLEDGE fdp LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FINPROD_ID,TRADE_ID,IS_CANCEL，SPLIT_TRADE_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL UNION ALL SELECT FINPROD_ID,TRADE_ID,IS_CANCEL，SPLIT_TRADE_ID FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL )tpd ON tpd.TRADE_ID = fdp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fdp.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID WHERE tpd.SPLIT_TRADE_ID = #{splitTradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND tpd.IS_CANCEL='N'
